name: Adam Joseph Laloge
headline: Design Engineer | Human-Centered AI Systems
summary: Design engineer and UI/UX software engineer building human-centered AI systems in regulated medical-device environments. Researches users, designs the interface, and writes the code behind it: HMI interfaces, backend services, AI agent workspaces, and embedded test hardware. Moderates usability sessions, translates findings into traceable system specifications, and validates the full stack against them.

experience.role: **Engineering Test Technician** (Full-Time Work While Completing B.S. Degree)

bullets.text: Moderate usability test sessions with end users of lab test software. Gather requirements and needs directly from users. Translate findings into formal traceable system specifications for internal tools developed full stack.
Design user interfaces and human machine interfaces (HMI) for automated test equipment and test software used daily by lab technicians.

Deliver end to end software development from user interface design through backend implementation. Build specialized AI agent workspaces that support automated testing and software development. Includes natural language protocol ingestion and automated traceability reporting. Turn usability and stakeholder feedback into shipped changes in real time, without a design-to-engineering handoff.
Design and build automated test equipment for medical device testing. Design, build, and validate test equipment with embedded controllers.
Perform verification testing of medical devices to rigorous compliance standards, maintaining requirements traceability throughout.
Present lab results and AI work at project reviews and internal showcases. Contribute to multiple invention disclosures.
Manage document control and validation data in enterprise PLM systems. Document product issues and escalate them to Engineering.
Perform electrical and mechanical assembly of projects from engineering documentation.

projects.title: **UWB Radar Research** | Ultra-wideband sensing on NXP hardware | In research

lines.text: Ultra-wideband radar sensing built on an NXP FRDM-RW612 host with an SR250 shield. The vendor ships on-chip presence detection and raw channel impulse response data; everything above that layer is designed and built from the raw channel data up. The targets are presence detection, fall detection, and contactless vitals.

projects.title: **Progressive Disclosure UI System** | Medical device information interface | Complete

lines.text: A progressive disclosure UI system that consolidates medical device information scattered across systems into one interface: the essentials on the surface, readable at a glance under time pressure, and the depth one layer down. Designed and built end to end, from research through code, and demonstrated live to executive leadership.

projects.title: **Atlas** | The site as a living map | Complete

lines.text: My site drawn as a galaxy instead of listed as pages: every project, photo, book, and post is a point of light set near the things it belongs with, and points connect when you probe them. Nothing is placed by hand; the map generates itself from the site's content and redraws as the site grows.
